title: Superhuman documents section
description: A product section on the light page: centred lockup, two-tone headline, lead and buttons, then a bento with one wide stone tile on top and two half-width tiles below (pale lilac and deep maroon). Text sits at the bottom-left of each tile and the media bleeds in from the right; on phones the text is on top and the media below.
notes: the maroon tile is a deep surface (chart-2) with light text
